title: fix(rest): escape the API docs viewer URL value for its HTML attribute context (ruling 3C)
body:
Fixes #25077

The API docs viewer (`GET {base}/docs`, `packages/rest`) builds the sibling openapi-document URL from the request and places it into a quoted HTML attribute of the served page. It interpolated that value into the attribute with no escaping, so a character the attribute context interprets reached the served markup as itself rather than as the matching HTML entity.

**Reach (abstract, per the #9387 disclosure ruling).** Reachable by an authenticated request through a mounted host; an anonymous request is refused before the render. Measured through both `IHttpServer` hosts this repo mounts these routes through. A URL carrying none of the interpreted characters is served byte-identically.

**The fix.** The value is escaped for its HTML attribute context at that one outlet — ruling 3C on #25040: every outlet that renders a value into HTML escapes it by the context it lands in. `packages/rest` had no HTML escaper; a package it depends on exports none and the repo's only escaper is private to another package this one does not import, so the fix adds a small local escaper in `packages/rest`. It is not re-exported, so the package's published surface is unchanged. Normal URLs stay byte-identical.

**The outlet-list pin.** `html-outlets.pin.test.ts` enumerates this package's HTML outlets by a source scan, asserts the list equals the declared set (today: one), asserts the declared outlet escapes the value for its context, and carries a positive control proving the scan finds the known outlet. It matches the shape and name of PR #25076's per-package outlet-list pin.

**Evidence.** The escaping pin is red on a hash-equal-restored ablation of the fix (the escaper reduced to identity) and green after; the byte-identical pin stays green under the identity ablation, as it should. The tests are named by what they assert — "a value carrying attribute-interpreted characters is escaped for the attribute context" and "an ordinary URL is served byte-identical" — and their inputs are the minimum characters the context interprets.

A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/rest` is included.

Clause-②: no

Held off (out of scope): the page's other content; `packages/spec/**`; PR #25076's files; the record export path (#25078, dispatched in parallel).
